name: Lana Prodanovic
bio: Lana Prodanovic was born on 11 July 2006 in Melbourne, Australia. She is an actress with experience in broadcasting and photography. She studied under filmmaker Danaë Grieef during high school at the Australian College of Dramatic Arts, developing a strong foundation in screen performance. Her work spans short films, independent projects, and television.
